body: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners has held the final close for its fifth flagship fund on $8.7bn, more than 50% larger than its predecessor. The oversubscribed fund, which hit its hard cap, will be used to help build energy companies that drive cleaner, more reliable and affordable energy.
